result.summary: The home screen is mostly well laid out. One clear data-rendering bug appears in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where the delivery fee shows 'NaN'. There is also a minor readability concern with the small gray secondary text.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee. This is a data or formatting bug leaking into the UI, and it makes the price unclear to users.
issues.suggestion: Validate the fee value before rendering. Show a fallback such as 'Delivery fee at checkout' or hide the fee when the data is missing, and fix the upstream calculation that produces NaN.

issues.description: Secondary text in light gray (delivery fees under the restaurant names, the meta line under Tokumaru Ramen Bar, and the search placeholder) is small and has low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the gray text to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) and consider a slightly larger font size.
